title: Labour MPs Discuss 'Coup' Against Keir Starmer During Drinks Event
text:
MPs and ministers supporting Wes Streeting have been secretly discussing a potential 'coup' against Keir Starmer, with plans to remove him from power when he is out of the country next month. The plot was discussed at a recent event in Westminster, where Immigration Minister Mike Tapp suggested July 8 as a possible date, coinciding with the NATO summit in Turkey. Rosie Wrighting, another Streeting supporter, suggested the move could even happen earlier. The conversation was recorded and obtained by the Daily Mail. Tapp initially denied involvement but later admitted to the discussion, stating he supports Streeting as PM but wants to avoid a lengthy leadership contest. Wrighting did not respond to requests for comment. Conservative Party chairman Kevin Hollinrake criticized the infighting, stating that it would only lead to more chaos and turmoil. Streeting has indicated he's prepared to trigger a leadership contest as early as next week, urging Starmer to step down 'on his own terms'.
